That keeps pointing to billings roughly half of what they were before August. The image has not been verified, receipt has not been acknowledged, and no pre-invoice heads-up was sent on Sep 30. Sarah filled in the agency-wide platform intake form within about 3 days ('Thanks Mel! I’ve just completed it 😊'). The backup IGs are at 57 days, the earnings plan at 55 days (Ronnie absent 49 days), the Sep 18 chargeback at 14 days unanswered, the credential cleanup at 42 days, the AI voice clone at 34 days, the OFTV write-up at 30 days and the Snapchat scope at 23 days. Vivek, Olivia and Derrek did not post. CHURN WATCH: the signals are mixed and better than last week. Against: she made a real ask, she was warm, she engaged with the intake, and she asked for nothing that looks like an exit (no exports, logins or data, no other agencies, no 'doing it myself'). For: she paid unusually fast (about 3 hours), the 4-5 week pattern of saying nothing about her main account continues, and she routed her ask to Mica rather than to her account manager. The fast payment only counts as a churn tell when it comes with zero asks, and this week it did not. If her Oct 1 call request is left hanging like her Sep 13-18 asks were, expect the withdrawal cycle to repeat.
